headline: FERRY 🛳️ CAPSIZES 💦 Killing 8 ☠️ Off Cyprus 🏝️
text:
EIGHT ☠️ KILLED 💀 and EIGHTEEN 🕳️ MISSING 😱 after that PASSENGER 🛳️ ferry 🍆 completely CAPSIZED 🌀 off NORTHERN 🧭 Cyprus 🏝️ the HEAD 🧠 of the TURKISH 🇹🇷 administration 🏛️ there has CONFIRMED ✅!! Ünal Üstel 🧔‍♂️ prime 🍆 minister 👔 of the self proclaimed TURKISH 🇹🇷 republic 🏛️ on Cyprus 🏝️ dropped ☎️ the BOMBSHELL 💣 that the boat 🛥️ was hauling 259 🧍‍♂️ passengers 🧳 and eight 👨‍✈️ crew 🧑‍🔧 when it started SWALLOWING 🌊 water 💧 after leaving 🏃‍♂️ the coastal 🏖️ town 🏘️ of Kyrenia 🏝️ on Sunday 🌅!! The ship's 🚢 captain 🧑‍✈️ and seven 🕖 crew 🧑‍🔧 members 🧍 have been DETAINED ⛓️ already as part of the probe 🔎 into exactly HOW ❓ this TRAGEDY 😭 occurred 🌀 Üstel 🧔‍♂️ posted 📱 on social media 📱!! "Priority 🥇 right now is HUMAN 🧍 life ❤️" he stressed 😤 while security 🚨 forces 💪 rescue ⛑️ teams 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 and health 🩹 officials 👨‍⚕️ all RUSHED 🏃 to the scene 🎬!!

OFFICIALS 🏛️ say the VAST 🌊 majority 🧮 of those ONBOARD 🛳️ have been RESCUED 🛟 already yet a full SEARCH 🔎 and RESCUE ⛑️ operation 🤝 with Turkish 🇹🇷 authorities 👮 is still UNDERWAY 🚤!! The boat 🛥️ has now SUNK 🏊‍♂️ completely and teams 👷 are scrambling 🏃‍♂️ to recover 📦 its BLACK ⚫ box 📦 recorder 📼 to figure out WHAT ❓ exactly went WRONG ❌!! The privately 🕴️ owned ferry 🛳️ left the popular 🏖️ holiday 🏖️ resort 🏨 of Kyrenia 🏝️ at about 12:30 🕛 local 🕒 time ⏰ which is 09:30 GMT 🌍!! Üstel 🧔‍♂️ revealed 📢 the boat 🛥️ was supposed to sail ⛵ to Turkey 🇹🇷 on Saturday 🗓️ but got DELAYED ⏳ due to nasty 🌧️ POOR ☔ weather 🌬️ conditions 🌊!!

HE 👨 told Turkish 🇹🇷 media 📰 outlet 📺 TRT 📡 that the boat 🛳️ got SMASHED 💥 by TWO ✌️ massive 🌊 WAVES 🌊 before it totally CAPSIZED 🌀 and started DRINKING 💧 water 💦 like a THIRSTY 🥤 sailor 🧜‍♂️!! While the captain 🧑‍✈️ was trying to RECOVER 🩹 from the FIRST 1️⃣ wave 🌊 a second 2️⃣ one SLAMMED 🚪 it HARD 🥊 and the hull 🛠️ began FLOODING 🌊 fast 🏃!! Helicopters 🚁 and coastguard 🛟 boats 🛥️ have been DEPLOYED 🚀 to the scene 🎥 while ambulances 🚑 sit parked 🅿️ on the beach 🏖️ ready to receive the SURVIVORS 🧍‍♂️ dripping 🥵 wet 💧!! Mustafa Koc 🧔 the local hero 🦸 who saved around SIXTYFIVE 65 🧍 people with his OWN 🛥️ boat 🛥️ told the BBC 📻 the crew should have WAITED ⏳ until the sea 🌊 was actually CALM 😌!!

"IT 🛳️ WASN'T safe 🛟 for them" Koc 🧔 said 😔 "the sea 🌊 was quite CHOPPY 🌊" and then he added 😢 "People died ☠️ It's not RIGHT ❌"!! The ferry 🛳️ a highspeed ⚡ 40m 📏 long and 10m 📏 wide Filo Jet 🛩️ vessel 🛥️ sails ⛵ under the Turkish 🇹🇷 flag 🏴 while the company 🏢 Filo Denizcilik said they are "deeply saddened 😭 by the tragic 😢 accident"!! A hotline 📞 has been SET 🛠️ UP ☝️ to give passengers 🧳 relatives 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 all the latest INFO 📋 and the nationalities 🌍 of those aboard 🛳️ plus the status of the injured 🤕 remain UNCLEAR ❓!! Local 📺 television 📺 broadcast 📡 images 🖼️ of the UPSIDEDOWN 🙃 ferry 🛳️ in the water 💧 with people 🧍 wearing life vests 🦺 standing on its HULL 🛠️!!

ON Sunday 🌅 evening 🌆 Arikli 🧔 the transport 🚚 minister 👔 of the self declared Turkish 🇹🇷 Republic of Northern Cyprus 🏝️ told TRT 📡 the ship 🛳️ had completely SUNK 🏊‍♂️ to the bottom 🌊!! Turkey's 🇹🇷 President 🧔 Recep Tayyip Erdogan sent his CONDOLENCES 🙏 to Turkish Cypriots 🏝️ and said efforts to reach those STILL ⏳ missing 😱 "continue uninterrupted" 🚤!! "Immediately after the accident 🌀 we launched extensive SEARCH 🔎 and RESCUE ⛑️ operations 🤝 in cooperation 🤝 with the authorities 👮 of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus 🏝️" he announced 📢 at a military 🎖️ ceremony 🎉 on Sunday 🌅!! Üstel 🧔‍♂️ promised 📜 the disaster 🌀 will be thoroughly investigated 🔎 and "even the slightest negligence 😣 will be uncovered" 🕵️ while adding "No one will be spared 🙅 regardless of who they are who is found at fault or responsible"!! The TRNC 🏛️ which is recognised only by Turkey 🇹🇷 controls the northern third 🧩 of the island 🏝️ of Cyprus that has been divided ✂️ since 1974 📅!!
